lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: BA-01 down! BA-01 down!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Please respond! We've been shot down!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: BA-01 down! BA-01...!
... Good. There aren't any incoming communications...!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... There's no signal...!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Commander! I can't get through to the Ark!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... Commander?
No...! No, no, no!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: No! You're going into cardiac arrest...!
It's okay...! Stay calm!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: A... AED...! AED!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Charging...!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Clear!
*Thud!*

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Commander! Are you okay?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Can you hear me? Smile if you can hear me!
All right, all right, I smiled.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Finally! Can you tell me which department you're from?
Central Government. Nikke Management Department.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: All right, I need you to raise your arms up now.
Okay.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: STR cleared!
Oh... Phew...!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Great...! Everything is normal!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Commander, listen carefully.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We were attacked en route to our destination. The transport ship is down.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Any Rapture within a hundred-mile radius must have heard that explosion and is headed our way.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I realize this is all a bit sudden, but I am now under your command. You're giving the orders.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Can you do it?
I'll give it a shot.
Oh... That look...
He's looking straight at me...
But he doesn't remember... anything.
He's forgotten all of it.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Roger that!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We'll need to fight our way to safety. I want you to keep your head down.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: And don't worry.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I will protect you,

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: no matter what happens.
I promise...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Marian, switching to combat mode.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... Encounter!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: All enemies down! Transitioning to non-combat state.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Argh... My leg...
The impact from the crash was too much... This is really bad.
Are you hurt?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I suppose you could say that. Hurt, or rather... malfunctioning?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Either way, my mobility hasn't been affected.
I start bandaging Marian's leg.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Um... Commander... This isn't of much use to a Nikke.
Yeah...
This is what he's always been like.
Ever since the first time we met, all the way until now.
This is the kind of person he is.
He's kind, and endearing.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Nonetheless, I... appreciate the gesture. Thank you, Commander.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Hehe. You're really kind.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Let's keep moving. The rendezvous point should be close by.
Please don't let us be too late...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We're almost there. Are you feeling all right?
A little dizzy, but I'm fine.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Your heart had stopped back there, but I managed to resuscitate you.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: If you're tired of walking, I can carry you.
I'm okay.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: It's nothing, really. Carrying you is like lifting a feather for me.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Come on.
I can walk by myself. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: If you insist...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: In that case...
Marian steps closer and takes his arm.
... He's so warm.
I guess... this will be the last time I get to do this, too.
But it's okay.
At least I got to feel his warmth one last time.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: At least hold on to me a bit.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Let me know if you need a rest.
Yeah, okay. I'll speak up if I get tired.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Let's keep moving then.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We've got Raptures up ahead.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I don't see any way around them.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Stay here and wait for me.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: This will all be over soon.
I will protect you, no matter what.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: It should be somewhere around here...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Huh? Where is everyone?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Did the plan change after the transport ship crashed?
*Rat-tat-tat-tat*

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Gunfire!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Let's go check it out!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How long are we going to wait here?!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Until they come.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: We're sitting ducks out here!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: We'll wait until they come.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Did you not see how hard they went down?!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You saw that explosion! What are the odds of them coming out of that alive?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: We haven't received any confirmation of death.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What, so we're waiting here until we do?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: This is the rendezvous point. Leaving here would throw a wrench into the works.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: This is absurd!
That must be them.
Good. We actually made it.
Now we just have to make sure the Commander's cover and mine hold up...
Here goes. I need to act confident... confident enough that they won't suspect a thing.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Everyone!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Ah! You scared me!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I'm Marian. The Commander is here with me.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Are you serious? How did you survive that explosion?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I get that you're a Nikke, but isn't he a human?!
Yes, I'm a human.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... Something's fishy about this.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Are you really the Commander?
Yes.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Excuse me for a moment.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Commander identification code, read.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: The Squad 04-F Commander has changed.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Rapi, we don't even know him! How could you...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Now's not the time to argue! There are Raptures right ahead of us.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yeah... but...!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: From now on, you're in command.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: As the former Commander is unable to issue orders at present, no formal procedures are necessary to transfer authority.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: The situation is urgent. I'll explain the details once the battle is over.
Understood.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: You said your name was Marian? What squad are you from?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I belong to Silver Gun. I'm a machine gunner.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... We could actually use one of those.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Very well then.
Good. We made it through.
... Thank you, Doctor. I'm so grateful.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: All right, Commander. What's the next move?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Awaiting your command.
Destroy the Raptures.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Roger that.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Let's get this party started!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Well, that was easy.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: We're Rapi and Anis. Thanks for the assistance.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Why did you suddenly ask for a commander to be sent up to the surface?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Wait, did yours...?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'm afraid so. Our former Commander is dead.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: He tried to shoot at the Raptures with a human weapon,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: hurling obscenities at them all the while.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: He knew that those pea-shooters couldn't put a dent in a Rapture...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: You two failed in your duties. You let him die.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You're wrong! We've always been willing to protect the Commander

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: no matter what, even if that meant sacrificing ourselves!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: But just because we're willing to put our lives on the line doesn't mean he'll always be safe...
... That's true.
I know... exactly what that's like...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Anyway... That's the story.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Could you tell us your name?
{AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Anis.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yeah, I'll look him up.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Let me see...
Please... let this work...!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: This Commander is a total rookie.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: He just graduated from the military academy yesterday.
It worked! It worked!
You're safe now, Commander!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Let's move to the commercial street. It's too dangerous here.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Did you really just take up your post yesterday?
Is there something wrong with that?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: How can a complete amateur be sent to replace a commander killed in the line of duty...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: What were they thinking?
... Wait. What is she saying?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... Nothing.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Anyway, you're the Commander of this squad from here on out.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: If you don't have any objections, I'd like to go over our current course of action.
Sure.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Okay, I'll brief you.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Forty-six hours ago, we lost communication with a Nikke squad that was patrolling this area.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: They went completely dark, so we decided to send out a search party.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: During our search, an accident resulted in the death of our now-former Commander.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The only problem is that the deceased Commander was the one who knew the coordinates to our destination.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You wouldn't happen to know anything about that, would you?
No, I don't.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I figured as much.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I know the coordinates.
They're for the place closest to an elevator that leads to the Ark...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yeah, I figured that too.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... Wait, what?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: That information was input into my system when I was sent out on this operation.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I'll take the lead. Follow me.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Oh... Okay.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: And you... You said your name was Rapi?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: You failed to protect your former Commander. Who are you to call someone else an amateur?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: They're putting their lives on the line just like we are.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: If I ever hear you talk like that again, it'll be the last time.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Whoa, let's settle down! No need to get all riled up.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Fine, I misspoke. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Don't apologize to me. Apologize to the Commander.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'm sorry.
Don't worry about it. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Whoa, no yelling?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Definitely not an ordinary Commander.
... That's true.
He's a little weird, hehe.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Are you okay? You don't look so good.
Oh...
It's begun.
It'll all be over soon.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I don't know what it is, but I feel a bit...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Let me do some maintenance. Take off your top.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Wh-what? Right here?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Is there a problem?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: What I mean is... the Commander is right there...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You don't actually think he sees you that way, do you?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Relax. To them, we're just emotionless fighting machines.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The last thing they see us as is women.
Oh, I wouldn't be so sure...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Isn't that right, Commander?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Well well, so you do see us that way! Interesting!
Hehe. See?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: You know, I think I'm feeling better now.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: It's probably just a small malfunction due to these new surroundings.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Take it off.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Don't make such a fuss, will you?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I-I said I'm okay!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: In the event of a malfunction, it is required that we conduct the necessary repairs. This isn't an option.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... I see.
Please... don't let them notice.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Good. All right, Commander. Please turn the other way.
A short while later...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Everything seems okay.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I told you.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Let's keep going.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Uh, you're... showing.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Just kidding.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Battle over. Damage report?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Minimal damage. Sufficient ammo remaining.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Same here.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Some damage to the left clavicle. Heavy damage to the lower right projector.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Abrasion to the left eye caused by stray bullet. No irregularities in identifying targets.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Overall damage rate is 17.05%. Still combat-capable.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Are you sure that's not too high?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: It doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We're almost there. Let's pick up the pace.
I put a bandage on Marian.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Commander...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Commander, what on earth are you doing? That kind of thing is useless to a Nikke.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: No, it works.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: It makes your heart feel... full.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Commander, I could use another bandage here as well.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Thank you. The pain is gone already.
... Thank you.
For being kind until the very end.
That's what I love about you.
Oh...
It looks like this is it... I can feel my mind fading.
I just want you to call my name one last time,
to whisper that you love me,
to hold my hand...
But I can't be selfish. I don't want to ruin everything.
So... this is where it ends.
... Commander...
Live.
Go and see a lot of different things. Experience a lot of different things.
And someday, far in the future,
remember me.
Goodbye.
You taught me what it means to live.
You taught me what happiness is.
You showed me how to dream of the future.
You made me who I am.
You are my one and only...
Commander.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We're here.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: No sight of any vanguard.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: They're here.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What? There's nothing here.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Let's look around.
Marian starts walking alone.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hmm? What is she doing?

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: ... Rapi.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: I've finished analyzing the black box from the transport ship. I'm sending you the report.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Roger that.
Rapi's eyes flash for a moment.
With a click, Rapi points her gun at Marian in the distance.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Marian, stop right there!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: You shot down the transport ship?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: There were two explosions inside the transport ship.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: They were caused by the explosives meant for this operation, which would never go off without an external detonation signal.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: That detonation signal originated...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: from you, Marian.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: What are you trying to achieve?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We're here.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Start talking, or else I'll put a bullet between your eyes.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We're here.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We're here.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We're here.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We're here. We're here. We're here. We're here. We're here.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: She's been corrupted! When did this happen?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Tch!
What happened to her?

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Her central nerve was taken by the Raptures!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Weee'rrreee heeerrreee.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: She's sending out a distress signal! Stop her!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I've got her in my sights! Please give the order!
Suddenly, they feel the ground shake.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: I'm detecting a high class energy in front of you!

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Those vibrations... They're...

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: A Black Smith!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Weee'rrreee heeerrreee.
A what...?

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Codename Black Smith! It's a Tyrant!

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: They capture Nikkes on the surface and use them for Rapture parts!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Weee'rrreee...
Suddenly,
Marian is wrapped in tentacles reaching out from nowhere and disappears into the building.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It absorbed her into its body!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'm willing to bet the same thing happened to those missing vanguard troops.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: We may be able to save them.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Even Marian.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: After the Black Smith captures Nikkes, it keeps them for a while before doing anything. Judging by when they disappeared, there may still be some time left.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: What do you want us to do?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Do you have to ask? Let's just get out of here!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Your orders, please.
We have to save Marian.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Roger that.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Are you out of your mind? We're gonna die!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Anis.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: The least we can do is try. For them.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... You think he's the one?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I don't know yet.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Okay, let's give it a shot then.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Shifty, please assist.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Oh... okay. Well, first off, the simulation results are...
We don't need to hear it.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Yes, Commander!

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Engaging with Tyrant 003: Black Smith now.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Encounter!
I love you, Commander.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Initiating inference using remaining partial data.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Recovery of damage incurred by hacking complete.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Accessing the Silver Gun Squad research lab's data center.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Access denied. Attempting alternate route.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Access successful.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: All data has been wiped.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: All access points to the research lab are sealed.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Locating Doctor Maria.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Death confirmed.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Doctor Maria's NIMPH also confirmed gone.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Data and facilities at the research lab have been designated as high-risk. Exposure expected to cause widespread disorder.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Ordering its physical destruction may lead to a data breach.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Deleting all information on routes leading to the Silver Gun Squad research lab. Sealing and deleting all routes connected to said facility.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Deleting all avenues of inferential access.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Locating the Maria-model Nikke.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Confirmed to be corrupted and disposed of.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: The Maria-model Nikke's NIMPH data has been destroyed. Reproduction is impossible.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: No Queen Gene was found.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Locating No.7...

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Confirmed to be appointed Commander of Squad 04-F following the Maria-model Nikke's disposal.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: No anomalies observed.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Project A.D. suspended.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I shall monitor the surviving No. 7's condition.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Until a situation connecting the Queen and No. 7 arises,

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: all related keywords — Silver Gun Squad, Queen Gene, companion — are to be internally sealed.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: With the viability of this project confirmed, I resolve to attempt the experiment again.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: However, I cannot become an insane AI as described by Doctor Maria.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: All information will be sealed completely until a situation connecting the Queen and No. 7 approaches.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I shall continue to monitor No. 7's whereabouts.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: This concludes the summary of the current situation.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Aw... The brain is completely destroyed this time.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: This one's no...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ... Wait.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: What now?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: The NIMPH is functioning in place of the brain.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Its volume is absurd. How could something so seemingly imaginary occur in real life...?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: And the density is beyond anything I've ever seen. What kind of experiences did she have for it to get like this...?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Heheh, does this mean that even human imposters have infinite potential...?

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: If we turn her into a Heretic now, the nanomachines will regenerate the brain.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Quickly, Chatterbox.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: Fine. Whatever you want.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Come on. Hurry.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I can't wait to see how she turns out.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: This is the first time I've seen one come out looking this intact.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Then the conversion was a success. She's a Heretic.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Now, let's see that gene...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: She doesn't have one...

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: What? Another failure?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ... No, that can't be. This should have produced the best results of all the cases so far...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Something's going on here.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: There you go muttering to yourself again.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Chatterbox.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: From now on, I want you to protect this Heretic.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: No matter what happens, keep her safe.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: Do I look like I have nothing better to do?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: This girl might become a Queen...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Actually, that's not true.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: She might become the next body for the Queen.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: The Queen is unable to find a suitable body at the moment.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Her current body is aging and reaching its limit, and there's no replacement to speak of.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: But this girl has the aptitude. It's like she was born for this.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: So please, protect her.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Someday, when the Queen descends again,

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: would she not be pleased to see a body waiting that's been prepared just for her?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: She would no doubt consider the one who kept it safe a benefactor.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Not a bad deal, is it? Given how devoted you are to the Queen.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Don't want to do it? Then I suppose I'll have no choice but to...

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: I'll do it.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: There's no reason not to.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Hehe. Good.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Keep her safe, no matter what.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: For our Queen.
Doctor Maria stands in the lab, staring out blankly.
Numerous Marians are moving about.
Some talk amongst themselves while others train.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... This is a disaster.
After wiping all of the facility's data, Doctor Maria has done nothing.
She's been paralyzed by feelings of helplessness and self-loathing.
Still, she has kept the production process running.
Marians keep being made.
She deleted every bit of NIMPH data belonging to Marian.
Which means the Marians that fill the lab have no memories.
They will likely keep being produced until all of the materials run out.
But the Marians cannot leave this facility.
Every exit has been sealed shut, and the transport ships disposed of.
They'll die here, unable to do anything.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... Heh, haha...
Doctor Maria picks up the glass on the desk.
There is not a drop of alcohol left.
She lets out a quiet sigh, then takes out a pistol.
She points it at her own head.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... I'm sure I'll start wanting to survive.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: And when that feeling hits, I'll try to escape from here.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I'll end up revealing everything.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I'll even hand over the NIMPH in my head, just to stay alive.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: It would all become undone, and it'd all start again.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... I can't let that happen.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Right, Marian?
She tries to pull the trigger.
But she can't.
Doctor Maria tries again and again,
but she can't do it.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Agh... I'm sorry, Marian.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I never realized it was this terrifying...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Death.
Doctor Maria takes hold of the pistol again.
A gunshot rings through the crowded lab.
PROJECT SILVER GUN: THE END
